title: mcp-guard Policy Configuration
description: Declarative tool/argument ACL, secret/PII redaction, and prompt-injection policy for @4sails/mcp-guard.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI for editor autocomplete and validation.

allow.description: Tool name globs permitted to execute. When non-empty, unlisted tools are denied by default.

deny.description: Tool name globs always blocked before upstream execution. Explicit deny always wins over allow.

argConstraints.description: Map of tool glob -> argument dot-path -> allowed primitive or glob values (fail-closed on missing args).

allowSecretFields.description: Per-tool argument dot-paths exempt from outbound secret redaction (e.g. vault secret writers).

redactPii.description: Redact or pseudonymize PII (email, phone, credit card, SSN, IBAN) on inbound MCP responses.

redactOutboundPii.description: Also redact PII on outbound agent -> MCP tool arguments (secrets are always redacted).

pseudonymizePii.description: Replace PII with session-consistent tokens ([EMAIL_1], [PHONE_1], etc.) while keeping secrets one-way redacted.

rehydrateOutboundPii.description: Opt-in outbound re-hydration of session PII tokens ([EMAIL_1]) back to upstream tools (boolean or per-tool glob allowlist). Secrets are never re-hydrated.

allowEmailDomains.description: Internal email domains exempt from EMAIL_ADDRESS redaction.

disabledRules.description: Built-in redaction rule IDs to suppress (e.g. PHONE_NUMBER).

customRules.description: Organization-specific secret regexes validated for syntax and ReDoS safety at policy load time.

allowPatterns.description: Regex patterns for known benign values that should never be redacted.

taintUntrusted.description: Wrap flagged string fields in [MCP_GUARD_UNTRUSTED_DATA ...] markers.

blockInjections.description: Replace/drop frames that hit a critical rule or >= blockMinRules distinct rules.

blockMinRules.description: Minimum distinct injection rules required to block when blockInjections is enabled.

threshold.description: Minimum alert severity reported by the prompt-injection tripwire.
